findings.reason: Danish stinke conjugates stinker → stank → har stunket (DDO: -r, stank, -t). 'Stinket' is at best a rare literary variant (ODS: l. br.); the standard teaching form matching gestunken is Stunket.
Danish ærgre conjugates ærgrer → ærgrede → har ærgret (DDO: -r, -de, -t). 'Ærgeret' inserts an extra e; the correct participle is Ærgret.
